confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate with no live listing checks. Restaurant and hostel anchors rest on general Malaysian price levels and are moderately grounded. The 3-star hotel, cocktail and wine anchors are less certain. Cocktail and wine were set from the beer anchor (about 2.5 to 3 times local draft beer) because direct Ipoh bar pricing knowledge is weak. The FX value comes from search-result snippets quoting the RBA exchange-rates page for 15 Oct 2026 (4pm), not from opening the RBA F11.1 table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Malaysian second-tier cities such as Melaka, priced below George Town and Kuala Lumpur. Cocktail and wine use a beer-relative basis as described in confidence_notes.
